review.method: Independent source comparison of rows 241-320 and context 237-240/321-324; equipment categories, material operations, model spellings and setting meanings verified. Actual UI geometry remains untested.
uncertainties: Hollowing is material removal for weight reduction; the customization view remains untested.
Output at row 298 is preserved generically because the source omits the output mode.
Activation Delay at row 306 is supported by the five-minute screen-saver message at row 86; the live settings screen remains untested.

source_storage: Source text remains on the original disc; bind by inventory ID and SHA-256.

notes.251: Hollowing means removing material to reduce weight; not deleting an item or stripping equipment.
notes.252: Rows 252-259 label model parts A-H. Part retains the generic source label; the actual customization view has not been inspected.
notes.260: Default Settings is the source's initial-settings label, distinct from row 292 Reset Settings.
notes.298: The output setting is adjacent to sound settings. Retain Output pending the actual audio-setting view.
notes.306: Activation Delay follows the screen-saver glow-color setting; row 86 identifies the configured delay before activation. Verify the settings screen.
notes.307: Marionette Units is the shop category for complete units, distinct from modification parts.
notes.312: Model names 312-318 are explicit Latin names in the source, approved by the parent. Retain their spellings without inferring character identity or gender.
notes.314: Valkyrje is the exact source Latin spelling. Do not silently normalize it to Valkyrie.
notes.316: Load capacity is the unit's carrying capacity; do not render it as ammunition capacity.
notes.317: Gryps is the exact source Latin spelling.
notes.319: Preserve the English category title plus parenthetical gloss and the distinction between ranged Main Weapons and close-combat Sub Weapons.
